sendTemperature.title: Send temperature
sendTemperature.description: Turn off for models that reject the parameter. A request a model refuses because of temperature is retried without it either way.

thinkingLevel.title: Thinking level
thinkingLevel.description: DEFAULT sends no thinking parameter. Only levels the selected preset or mapping offers are sent; run Thinking Levels to see them.

thinkingPreset.title: Thinking preset
thinkingPreset.description: model-default sends nothing. auto follows the protocol; the others are request-fragment templates. A blank Thinking mapping uses the preset template.

thinkingMapping.title: Thinking mapping
thinkingMapping.description: Optional JSON keyed by level, e.g. {"HIGH":{"reasoning_effort":"high"}}. Overrides the preset template; clear it to restore the preset. Run Thinking Help for the rules and the preset template.

modelProfiles.title: Model profiles
modelProfiles.description: Named connection settings. Add, rename, edit, copy and remove rows here. One profile is active at a time; a blank Active model keeps using the single settings above. Every profile has its own token limit, key slot and thinking settings. Keys are plugin secrets under Settings > Plugins > Secrets, never text in this table.

secretSlot.title: Key slot
secretSlot.description: Which declared plugin secret this profile sends. Fill each slot under Settings > Plugins > Secrets.

thinkingLevel.title: Thinking level
thinkingLevel.description: DEFAULT sends nothing. Thinking Levels lists the levels this mapping really offers.

thinkingPreset.title: Thinking preset
thinkingPreset.description: Request-fragment family. A blank Thinking mapping uses the preset template.

thinkingMapping.title: Thinking mapping
thinkingMapping.description: Optional JSON keyed by level; overrides the preset template. Clear it to restore the preset.

activeModel.title: Active model profile
activeModel.description: Name of the model profile to use. Blank uses the single settings above. This Project value overrides the Global one; leave it blank in a project to inherit the global choice.
